description: Weaker augmentation only in the low-resolution stages, following D014 C0193: small images want weaker augmentation, as in EfficientNetV2's progressive learning. This replaces the all-stage translate removal, I063. On the tip (E048, or I066's successor if it is kept), make one change: turn off translate-2 during the 20 px and 28 px stages (epochs 0-3.0) and keep it in the 32 px stage. The alternating flip and brightness/contrast jitter stay in every stage. Translate is pad-and-random-crop inside the compiled augment, so use a separate augment variant for the low-res stages and pick it in Python by stage. Never put a data-dependent branch in the graph. Tensor shapes are unchanged. Warm up the new augment variant in build() with channels_last tensors of the exact timed layout. The RNG stream for flips and jitter should stay as is where possible; note in the run log whether the translate draws are skipped, since skipping them shifts the downstream RNG. Eval is unchanged.
